reviews.text: 种植物收获资源→拍房子增加人口→招地精灵活塔防，一个以花园地精为主题的塔防肉鸽游戏；每回合会解锁随机地块，出现随机行进路线的敌人巢穴；可以移动地精位置或者种植带有阻挡性质的植物来改变敌人的行动路线；有7种地精职业大量的植物还有遗物互相搭配，随着游戏进度会解锁共16种初始搭配和8个区域[spoiler][strike]当然不同区域中后期体验是否同质化是不确定的，我还没玩太久[/strike] 经验证，每个区域都有不同的地形和敌人类型，所以并不同质化，反而由于随机性导致攻克难度偏高[/spoiler]；另外还有每日挑战和纯随机模式； ---有两点希望制作组改进： 1.没有窗口化后的分辨率选项，每次进游戏都要重新更改窗口大小，很麻烦； 2.没有职业、植物和遗物的图鉴，我想挨个翻译也无从下手； 指南在这： https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3461260080 ---I hope to see two improvements in future patches: 1. Add a resolution option in window mode, so no need to change the window size every time open the game: 2. Add an illustrated guide in game to list what things do, like plants, relics and so on, if you know what I mean. -------------------------------------------------------------- 吐槽一下无尽模式第二轮以后，玩家这方单个地精或者说所有的输出完全跟不上敌人的血量成长速度，只能靠铺路的方式堆量延长敌人的行进路线，玩的很不爽；小tips：想要经济爆炸选最后一个解锁的组合Weeds，开局商店roll个“物件被摧毁就退钱”的回收站遗物，就不用靠种植赚钱了。

In the current GPU shortage, this game reminds me that fun can still be had on an i3 laptop. If black ops 6 is 102 GB then you could fit around 2550 Gnomes for each copy of BO6. How do you know if a video game is good? Custom built engine designed for the game Not using Unreal Engine Fair pricing No microtransactions Mobile port potential Is exactly what it says it is default background is black (OLED users be edging) Has unique soundtrack for each level that is memorable Every level is unique and presents new challenges Every level has new enemies and unique bosses with unique abilities Same pace from the beginning to the end (End game not rushed, for example) Extremely Optimized 40 megabytes Stable 120 FPS on integrated graphics Has random mode and endless mode for replay value What other game has most of these features? Slay the spire Binding of Isaac Enter the gungeon Spelunky Dead cells That's how you know you got a good game. The age of triple A is over.

Gnomes is a nice little game, but theres just too much info it doesnt give you, despite having the tutorial enabled. Certain crops/plants dont tell you in their description which kind of ground they grow on, for example. Bosses regenerate hp, and dont seem to be slowed by swamp, two things that, because the game didnt tell me, cost me a run. Certain Gnome types are clearly weaker than others, despite costing the same (or more) gold as their superiors. The game *can* be good. It just needs a bit of work in making more info known to the player. Losing a match because of bad tower placement is one thing, losing because you literally didnt know what the game doesnt tell you is another thing entirely.

又一款复古画风精致小游戏，《矮人防线》采用了和循环英雄一样的复古画面风格，同样采取简单的布置玩法构筑游戏，只不过不同的是本作更注重于游戏塔防和资源管理这一块，不同于大多数塔防游戏的以塔为基的设计，本作是要建造各种小矮人来应付袭来的哥布林，这是一场事关矮子中谁最强的较量，适合喜欢策略塔防的玩家。 很难看到一种塔防游戏，既有着传统塔防的神韵，又不乏肉鸽随机的美感，再兼具足够独特的美术风格，很高兴的是矮人防线就是如此，本作塔防与肉鸽两手都抓，两者设计都很有趣，不再是传统建塔收钱继续建塔的纯粹循环，更多的随机乐趣加入其中让游戏的体验也提升了一个档次。 游戏中最独特的设计是可以自由移动的布局，每一个回合玩家都可以自由移动矮人单位，随意的布置防御设施与作物，以准备迎击夜晚的哥布林入侵，更加自由的地图布局和四面八方袭来的敌人让游戏的布局和玩法不再固化，可以根据居民啊变换更加有利的设置，而且玩家如果在部分敌人行进线路进行布防，还可能改变敌人的走向，算是塔防中较为有趣味的设计模式了。 此外游戏目前一共有8种不同的地图模式，每一种不同的地图都代表着不同的开局组合，适配的建筑和遗物体系也不尽相同，通过合理的搭配各种模式的矮人和遗物，建造各种配合建筑物来获取更高的收益，打造更加强力的防御矩阵。 就目前体验而言，本作创新的玩法、丰富的策略组合、多样的地图生态以及复古的8bit像素风格，都让我感受到了塔不同于传统塔防游戏的那一面，无论是可玩性和新鲜感亦或是策略深度都很不错，是近期带给我最有趣体验的策略塔防游戏。 [quote] 游玩百态，将游玩心得用汉语化作玩家的指明灯，(๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35402408/]点击这里关注汉化语录~[/url] 如果喜欢这个评测，请点个赞让更多人看见 [/quote]

It’s kind of a unique spin on tower defense which is neat but I didn’t like the spin. Instead of having fixed points for your tower you have to move your units (and potentially other things) around every single time which gets a bit tedious. The very beginning of each run is fairly repetitive but you can choose multiple different starting “factions” and different maps which play fairly differently. I’m more of a fan of the Kingdom Rush type of tower defense, I appreciate that they tried something new but it wasn’t for me. I think the roguelite elements kind of did the game a disservice as well – I think if they made the experience a bit tighter it would’ve been a lot better as just a straight up TD game with a campaign, and then have an optional roguelite endless mode if you want.

A decently fun and, towards the end, challenging game. However, some items and artifacts are so much stronger than others that later stages seem to have less strategic variety than the earlier levels. Even though the game has many classes of gnome, you most likely will not use more than one of them per level because of two reasons. 1) you only start with one class, so you have to spend precious gold to buy extra classes. 2) there are class specific artifacts and limited artifact slots. 3) there's no synergies between different classes of gnomes. Buying wedding ring to exploit knife gnome's insanely low cooldown doesn't count as synergy. Combining gnomes that stun with gnomes that deal high damage doesn't count as well because gnomes that stun also deal high damage AND AOE. In fact, they have more AOE than all most all other gnomes. Gnomes aren't the only problem. You need gold to buy gnomes. Later levels create challenging scenarios by making it difficult to generate enough gold. All this falls apart when you realize you can spend 12 gold to buy yawn and strong root, which will generate hundreds of gold in a few turns. No other economy can match this. The only time I can get this many gold is with a cactus maze. As a tower defense game, where you place your gnomes is very important. But this game let you bypass that as well. Once you have a decent economy, you can buy enough gnomes to make a maze, which is objectively the best way. Other tower defense game prevent this by changing the terrain. However, this game has items that allows you to change the terrain to your heart's content, for cheap too! So, there's no reason to not make a maze when you can do it. When you don't have the money, that's fine too! Just grind the RNG for wedding ring (18 - 20 gold) and knife gnome. With wedding ring, 4 pairs of knife gnome and blunderblast gnome can beat the final level which has a final boss with 666 HP. Or you can just grind the RNG for yawn and strong root combo. It's really your choice. TL;DR: as an indie game, it's pretty good, but it needs balancing more than content.

The game immediately presents itself with nice-looking maps and satisfying sounds, paired with a classic arcade-style aesthetic and bright colors. Despite this, it has several issues that led me to not recommend it. First of all, the imbalance introduced by the latest update: in order to make the new items usable, other elements were changed, making many builds far less viable in the late game (20+ days) and ultimately hurting the game’s depth (something the shop’s RNG doesn’t help with). Additionally, guilds feel more like memes or challenge runs (sometimes even “not self-sufficient”) rather than solid starting points to build a strategy around. On top of that, the inability to have more than one save/run at a time (even across different modes) is a major drawback, and the shop RNG is far too influential, forcing you to restart over and over just to get the upgrades needed to make a guild actually functional.

Gnomes is a breath of fresh air in the tower defense genre. A must-play for strategy game enthusiasts.
I can’t get enough of the variety in gnome abilities and relics. They truly change the way you approach each battle.
Great attention to detail in the environment design. It’s clear that a lot of effort went into creating unique biomes.
Every game feels different thanks to the diverse biomes and unique gnome guilds. Endless replayability.
I played a lot of similar games, but Gnomes stands out due to its fun TDstyle gameplay and charming aesthetics.
